Job Opening - Equipment Operator
The Town of Windsor, MA Has a Full Time Opening for an EQUIPMENT OPERATOR
Minimum requirements are class B CDL, and 2A Hoisting License. Duties include maintenance and repair of roads and related facilities, maintenance of vehicles and equipment, snow and ice removal, emergency overtime required.
Applications are available in the Town Offices located at 1890 Route 9, Windsor, MA 01270 or on Windsormass.com. A completed and signed application must be sent to The Town Offices, Suite 1 or emailed to
Highway@windsormass.com
POSTING DATE: October 5, 2026
CLOSING DATE: October 16, 2026 or until filled.
The Town of Windsor is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Municipal Aggregation Plan (Updated 9/10/26)
For Windsor participants in Electricity Aggregation:
As of August 1st, Eversource has posted the new rate for residential electricity: $0.15934/ kWh. This is an increase that puts Eversource's rate higher than the aggregation rate, which is $0.14292/ kWh.
The Green Committee is recommending that everyone who opted out of aggregation over the last period, (when Eversource's rates were the lower of the two), consider opting back in. Anyone who had opted out of aggregation at any point is welcome to join in for lower rates. If you never opted out... you are automatically in!
To opt in: go to or call First Point at 888-875-1711 and ask to opt in.To access Eversource's basic service rates visit
